about.title: About EkipTrade
about.intro1: EkipTrade is the leading marketplace for buying and selling used agricultural and industrial equipment in Europe. Since our creation, we connect thousands of professionals to facilitate their transactions.
about.intro2: Our mission is simple: to offer a reliable, transparent and efficient platform to help farmers, dealers and companies find the equipment they need at the best price.
about.trustDesc: All our sellers are verified and every listing is checked to ensure your safety.
about.communityDesc: More than 5,000 agricultural and industrial professionals trust us every day.
about.serviceDesc: Personalized support to facilitate your transactions from A to Z.
about.qualityDesc: A rigorous selection of equipment to meet professional requirements.
about.joinDesc: More than 1,000 listings published every month by verified professionals.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Buying or selling agricultural and industrial equipment has never been easier
howItWorks.step1Desc: Browse our catalog of thousands of agricultural and industrial machines. Use filters to refine your search by category, brand, price or location.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Interested in a listing? Contact the seller directly via our secure form. Ask your questions and request additional information.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Exchange with the seller to agree on the price and terms. Arrange a visit to inspect the equipment before purchase.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Complete the transaction directly with the seller. We support you to ensure a smooth buying experience.
howItWorks.sellerDesc: Post your listings for free and reach thousands of potential buyers. Our team verifies each listing to ensure the quality of our platform.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quickly find answers to your questions
faq.q1: How do I post a listing?
faq.a1: To post a listing, you must first create a seller account. Once logged in, click on "Post an ad" and fill in the form with your equipment details. Add quality photos to increase your chances of sale.
faq.a2: Yes, posting basic listings is completely free. We also offer premium options to highlight your listings and reach more potential buyers.
faq.q3: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a3: Each listing has a contact form. Fill in your details and message, and the seller will receive your request directly by email. You can also call directly if the number is displayed.
faq.a4: We verify the identity of all professional sellers. Listings are also checked before publication to ensure compliance with our terms of use.
faq.a5: The warranty depends on the seller and the type of equipment. Professional sellers are required to comply with legal warranty obligations. We advise you to always ask for warranty details before purchasing.
faq.q6: Can I have the equipment delivered?
faq.a6: Delivery is to be arranged directly with the seller. Some sellers offer transport services, others prefer hand delivery. Feel free to discuss the terms during your exchanges.
faq.q7: How do I report a fraudulent listing?
faq.a7: If you suspect fraud, use the "Report" button on each listing or contact our customer service. We treat each report with the utmost attention.
faq.a8: Payment is made directly between buyer and seller. We recommend using secure and traceable payment methods. Beware of unusual payment requests.

seo.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
seo.description: Learn about our returns and refunds policy for agricultural and industrial equipment. Right of withdrawal, return conditions, shipping costs, and refund process.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.subtitle: We are committed to your satisfaction. Discover our returns and refunds policy for a worry-free shopping experience.

importantNotice.title: Important Information
importantNotice.description: As a professional seller of agricultural and industrial equipment, we comply with European consumer protection legislation. Please read this policy carefully before making a purchase.

withdrawal.title: Right of Withdrawal
withdrawal.intro: In accordance with European consumer law (Directive 2011/83/EU), you have the right to withdraw from your purchase within a specified period without giving any reason.

period.title: 14-Day Withdrawal Period
period.description: You have 14 calendar days from the date of receipt of the goods to exercise your right of withdrawal. To exercise this right, you must notify us of your decision by email or post before the deadline expires.

eligible.title: Eligible Products
eligible.item1: New equipment in its original packaging
eligible.item2: Used equipment not yet started or tested by the buyer
eligible.item3: Accessories and parts in their original packaging
eligible.item4: Equipment that has not been modified or customized

excluded.title: Exclusions
excluded.item1: Equipment made to customer specifications or clearly personalized
excluded.item2: Goods that deteriorate rapidly or have a short shelf life
excluded.item3: Sealed goods that are not suitable for return for health or hygiene reasons
excluded.item4: Equipment that has been started, used, or damaged after delivery

step1.title: Contact our customer service
step1.description: Send a return request by email to infos@ekip-trade.com or by post. Include your order number, the reason for the return, and your contact details.

step2.title: Receive return authorization
step2.description: Our team will review your request and send you a return authorization (RA) number within 48 business hours, along with detailed return instructions.

step3.title: Prepare and ship the equipment
step3.description: Carefully pack the equipment in its original packaging if possible. Clearly affix the RA number to the package and ship the goods to the indicated address.

step4.title: Inspection and refund processing
step4.description: Upon receipt, we will inspect the equipment. If everything is in order, your refund will be processed within 14 days of receiving the returned goods.

conditions.title: Return Conditions
conditions.intro: To be accepted, returns must meet the following conditions:
conditions.item1: The equipment must be returned within 14 days of obtaining the RA number
conditions.item2: It must be in its original condition, unused and undamaged
conditions.item3: Original packaging must be intact and complete (accessories, documentation, etc.)
conditions.item4: The RA number must be clearly visible on the package
conditions.item5: All identification labels and seals must be intact

warning.title: Depreciation
warning.description: If the returned equipment shows signs of handling beyond what is necessary to establish its nature, characteristics, and proper functioning, a depreciation may be deducted from the refund amount.

shipping.title: Return Shipping Costs
shipping.intro: Responsibility for return shipping costs depends on the reason for the return:

withdrawal.title: Withdrawal (change of mind)
withdrawal.description: Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the buyer. We recommend using a tracked and insured shipping service given the value of the equipment.

defective.title: Defective or non-conforming product
defective.description: If the product is defective or does not match the description, return shipping costs are covered by EkipTrade. We will arrange collection or reimburse you for shipping costs.

note.title: Note:
note.description: For large or heavy equipment, please contact us before shipping to arrange appropriate logistics.

refund.title: Refund Terms
refund.intro: Once the return is validated, your refund will be processed according to the following terms:

timeline.title: Processing Time
timeline.description: Refund within 14 days of receiving the returned equipment, or from the date of proof of shipment if earlier.

method.title: Refund Method
method.description: Refund via the same payment method used for the original purchase (bank transfer, PayPal, etc.).

deduction.title: Possible Deductions
deduction.description: Initial shipping costs will only be refunded if the return is due to an error on our part or a defective product. Depreciation may be deducted in case of damaged or incomplete equipment.

warranty.title: Legal Warranty
warranty.intro: In addition to the right of withdrawal, you benefit from legal warranties under European law:

legal.title: Warranty of Conformity
legal.description: Valid for 2 years from delivery for consumers. The product must conform to the sales contract and be suitable for its intended use.

hidden.title: Hidden Defects
hidden.description: You may request resolution of the sale within 2 years of discovering a hidden defect that makes the product unsuitable for use.

warranty.options: Under these warranties, you may choose between:
warranty.option1: Repair or replacement of the equipment
warranty.option2: Price reduction if repair is not possible
warranty.option3: Full refund if the defect is significant

contact.intro: For any questions regarding returns or refunds, our customer service is at your disposal:
contact.include: For a quick response, please include in your message:
contact.include3: A detailed description of the issue encountered
contact.include4: Photos if applicable (for defective or damaged equipment)
